meta.title: Recreate Order: Create Order with negative evaluation duration is rejected

plan.title: Reject Negative Evaluation Duration on Recreate Order

steps.note: Open the existing awarded event's summary page.
Open Recreate Order from the RFQ stage Settings menu.
Select custom evaluation duration so the numeric duration field is available.
Enter the invalid negative evaluation duration.
Assert that Create Order is rejected rather than creating an order with a negative evaluation duration.
